name: Matus and Flusser Discrete Radon Transform
definition: Defined on a $p \times p$ table where $p$ is prime. The continuous Radon transform integral is replaced by a discrete sum on lines $k = ml + t \mod p$ for all intersection points $0 \le t \le p$, for a line slope $m$ such that $0 \le m \le p$. The image space is considered toroidal.
